evidence: 2026-09-30: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (MCP session, vault-minted password). After the work email Asana sent "Action Required: Reserve your Asana account" with a code; the account owner entered it through a challenge handoff (outcome solved). A Welcome step then asked for a full name and a new password; both were accepted and the page went on to onboarding. A fresh sign-in with the same credentials was then accepted.
gotchas: Email-first: after the work email, Asana sends a code by email ("Reserve your Asana account"); the code belongs to the account owner: hand it off. After the code a Welcome step asks for a full name and a new password on the same page.
The Welcome step shows a minimum-length rule for the password; the vault's 24-character default passed.

Email-first: after the work email (Enter submits it) the page says a six-digit code was emailed, but on 2026-10-09 the mail ('Reserve your Asana account') carried only a verification link to app.asana.com/app/asana/-/register; opening that link continued the signup. The link belongs to the account owner.

After the link, a Welcome step on app.asana.com asks for Full name and Password (at least 8 characters). Clicking 'Get started' timed out; Enter in the password box submitted it and moved to onboarding (progress bar 'Step N of 5').
Sign-in at app.asana.com/-/login is email-first: email, Enter (clicking Continue timed out), then password + Enter; no new-device code was asked on 2026-10-09 and it landed on the onboarding steps.
